correctness.rationale: Given power spectrum and nonzero coefficients on S=H union(a+H), ratios are unit-modulus phases. Equality of nonzero conjugate mixed cubic entries forces rho(0)=1, rho|H=chi a character and rho(a+h)=alpha chi(h). Below polyspectral order q+1 at most q-1 inputs are in a+H; a sum within S can only have quotient count 0 or1 mod q, so arbitrary alpha remains invisible. The first closure at q copies of a yields alpha^q=chi(qa), exactly the condition for extending chi and alpha to a full group character (hence physical translation); nonroot alpha supplies genuine lower-order nontranslation ambiguity. For sparse fixed entries, recursive generation of the invariant factors of H, generator closures, cross-coset recursions, and one q-fold tuple suffice with 1+(h-1-d)+d+(h-1)+1=2h entries. Less than 2h nonzero monomial phase rows have positive-dimensional torus kernel, whereas the translation group is finite: hence cannot uniformly separate all phases. Exactly two cosets, all nonzero Fourier coefficients, exact mixed conjugate polyspectra, and magnitudes already known are indispensable assumptions.
